Strap Series: Notes and Footnotes (Simpson Strong-Tie Coiled & Precut Strap Ties - C-C-2026 & strongtie.com):

1. Allowable tension loads include the wind/seismic load duration factor C_D = 1.60 for fastener-controlled capacities, or are limited by the steel net section tension capacity (1.00 steel limit; no further increase permitted).

2. Install half of the total specified fasteners on each side of the joint centerline (symmetric nailing/screwing required). Where fewer fasteners are installed than specified, reduce the fastener-controlled allowable load linearly per nail/screw (must not exceed steel net section limit).

3. For Coiled Straps (CS, CMST, CMSTC), Minimum Total Cut Length L_total = Clear Span + 2 x (End Length). When lap splicing two coiled straps, overlap by at least L_sp and install the specified lap splice fasteners plus the full end fasteners on each side of the splice.

4. Fastener edge distance in wood members must be >= 3/8 in. to prevent wood splitting. For CS and LSTA/MSTA installed on the narrow edge of 2x lumber (1-1/2 in. wide), center the 1-1/4 in. strap carefully.
